Aceptance Criteria

AC-01 — ShareButton: "Copy review link" option

# Criterion How to verify
01-01 "Copy review link" appears as a third menu item in the popover only when reviewUrl prop is provided Render ShareButton without reviewUrl → item must be absent. Render with reviewUrl → item must appear.
01-02 "Copy review link" appears below "Share to LinkedIn", separated by a visible divider Inspect popover DOM order and divider element.
01-03 Clicking "Copy review link" calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(reviewUrl) Mock clipboard API; assert writeText is called with the exact reviewUrl value.
01-04 On clipboard write success, the popover closes immediately Assert popover is not visible after successful copy.
01-05 On clipboard write success, a toast notification confirms the action Assert toast fires (e.g. "Review link copied!").
01-06 After a successful copy, the "Copy review link" menu item shows a green checkmark icon + "Copied!" label for at least 2 seconds Observe state; at t+1s label is still "Copied!"; at t+2.1s label reverts to "Copy review link".
01-07 Copying the review link does not reset or trigger the "Copy link" (profile URL) button state, and vice versa Copy profile link → assert review icon unchanged. Copy review link → assert profile icon unchanged.
01-08 When navigator.clipboard.writeText is unavailable or throws, a read-only fallback <Input> appears inside the popover pre-filled with reviewUrl Simulate clipboard API failure; assert fallback input is rendered with correct value and is auto-focused/selected.
01-09 ⚠️ The review link item uses a semantically appropriate icon (e.g. MessageSquarePlus, not Star) Visual inspection — Star currently used; candidate for icon swap.
01-10 ⚠️ The popover includes a micro-label (e.g. "Request a review") above the review link item to clarify intent Visual inspection — currently absent.
01-11 All three menu items meet a minimum tap target height of 44px Inspect computed height via DevTools.
01-12 Each menu item has a visible focus ring when navigated by keyboard Tab through popover; assert focus ring is visible on each item.
01-13 The aria-label on the "Copy review link" button updates to "Review link copied" when in the copied state Inspect aria-label attribute after click.

AC-02 — Review landing page: valid photographer slug

# Criterion How to verify
02-01 GET /photographer/[slug]/review returns HTTP 200 for a valid slug curl or Playwright assertion.
02-02 Page renders the photographer profile card with: name, avatar, star rating, review count, location (city + country), and website (if present) Visual inspection at 375px and 1280px.
02-03 Profile card avatar displays the photographer's photo; falls back to the generated avatar when avatar is null Test with a photographer that has no avatar.
02-04 Page renders two identity verification options: LinkedIn (primary CTA) and email with reCAPTCHA (secondary) Visual inspection — must not show a direct unverified form.
02-05 Privacy disclosure ("We only use your name and profile photo…") is visible without scrolling on a 375 × 667 px viewport Resize browser to 375px wide; confirm disclosure is above the fold.
02-06 LinkedIn button has minimum height 44px and is full-width on mobile Inspect computed height; test at 375px.
02-07 Clicking LinkedIn button shows a loading spinner + "Connecting to LinkedIn…" label and disables the button Click and inspect within 100ms.
02-08 While LinkedIn OAuth URL is loading, the email input and "Send Link" button remain interactive Click LinkedIn → immediately attempt to type in email input → input must accept keystrokes.
02-09 On LinkedIn OAuth success, browser performs a full-page redirect (window.location.href) — not a popup Assert window.location.href is set, not window.open called.
02-10 On LinkedIn OAuth failure (network error / backend error), an inline error message appears below the LinkedIn button and the button re-enables Simulate error response; assert error text and re-enabled button.
02-11 ⚠️ LinkedIn OAuth request times out after ~10 seconds and shows the inline error Simulate a hung request; assert error appears within 10–11 seconds and spinner stops.
02-12 Email input has a visible <label>, type="email", autocomplete="email", and minimum height 44px Inspect DOM.
02-13 Email validation runs on blur (not on keystroke) Type an invalid email, tab away → error appears. Type while focused → error must not appear yet.
02-14 reCAPTCHA widget is visible and must be solved before "Send Link" becomes active Assert button is disabled before reCAPTCHA token; enabled after.
02-15 ⚠️ Helper text explains why "Send Link" is disabled (e.g. "Complete the reCAPTCHA above to continue") Visual inspection — currently absent.
02-16 Clicking "Send Link" calls sendEmailReview with the entered email and photographer slug Mock data layer; assert call with correct args.
02-17 On email send success, an inline success message reads: "We sent a review link to [email] — please check your inbox." Verify the sent email address appears in the message.
02-18 ⚠️ On email send success, the "Send Link" button transitions to a "Sent!" state with a checkmark for ≥2 seconds Visual inspection — currently button reverts to disabled "Send Link".
02-19 On email send failure, an inline error message appears with the server error text Simulate API error; assert error shown.
02-20 Email success/error messages are announced to screen readers via role="status" / role="alert" ⚠️ Inspect DOM — currently missing role attributes on email feedback divs.
02-21 "Back to [name]'s profile" link is present and navigates to /photographer/[slug] Click link; assert URL.
02-22 Page renders without horizontal scroll at 375px viewport width Resize browser; assert no overflow-x.
02-23 Page <head> robots meta is index: false, follow: false Inspect meta tag or generateMetadata output.
02-24 Page <title> is "Leave a review for [Photographer Name]" Inspect document title.

AC-03 — Review landing page: invalid / not-found slug

# Criterion How to verify
03-01 GET /photographer/unknown-slug/review renders the "Photographer not found" error page (not a blank page or unhandled 500) Navigate to a non-existent slug.
03-02 Error page shows a plain-language message and a "Browse photographers" link to the directory home Visual inspection.
03-03 Error page does not expose slug values or internal error details in the UI Inspect rendered HTML.

AC-04 — Photographer profile: reviewUrl passed to ShareButton

# Criterion How to verify
04-01 PhotographerProfile passes reviewUrl computed as ${SITE_URL}/photographer/${slug}/review to ShareButton Inspect props in React DevTools or read component source.
04-02 The passed reviewUrl uses the exact same slug as the profile page — no hardcoded values Test with two different photographer slugs; assert each review URL contains the correct slug.

AC-05 — Cross-cutting

# Criterion How to verify
05-01 tsc --noEmit passes with zero new errors Run in CI.
05-02 No "coming soon" toast exists anywhere in the codebase for the LinkedIn button on any surface grep -r "coming soon" returns no matches in src/.
05-03 All features tested in: Chrome (latest), Safari iOS 16+, Chrome Android Manual QA sign-off.
05-04 No regression in existing "Copy link" (profile URL) or "Share to LinkedIn" ShareButton behaviors Smoke-test both options after the review link change.
05-05 ⚠️ LinkedIn share popover item uses an anchor-based redirect instead of window.open popup to avoid iOS Safari popup block Inspect handleLinkedIn implementation — currently uses window.open.

🧪 QA Tester Results — Issue #9 · Implement Share Review Link Dropdown Menu at Share Button

Tester: automated (Playwright) · Target: https://360photographers.org · Browser: Chromium (headed, maximized) · Result: 🟡 functional core passed — 1 functional bug + acceptance-criteria gaps logged below (issue kept open)

🐞 QA Bug Findings (action required)

All core flows work — copy review link, toast/confirmation, LinkedIn + email options, invalid-slug handling, backend all 200. The items below are deviations from the acceptance criteria that still need developer attention, so this issue is kept open and labeled note bug. Each finding includes a screenshot; the full continuous reproduction is in the 🎬 screen recording.

🔴 Functional bug

  • 01-04 — the Share popover does NOT close after clicking "Copy review link". The spec requires the popover to close on copy; it stays open, which directly conflicts with AC-01-06. (scenario S7)

🟠 UX / accessibility gaps

  • 03-02 — the invalid review-link page has no "Browse photographers" link → a user landing on a dead/expired link hits a dead end with no route back to the directory. (S14)

  • 02-05 — the privacy disclosure sits below the fold at 375×667 (the profile card stacks above the form; its bottom ≈ 872px). The spec requires it visible without scrolling on mobile. (S9)

  • 02-13 — the email field has no on-blur validation (it validates only on submit, which is reCAPTCHA-gated). (S10)

🟡 Minor / cosmetic

  • 01-09 review icon is Star (spec: MessageSquarePlus) · 01-10 missing "Request a review" micro-label (S7, screenshot above) · 02-15 no "complete the reCAPTCHA…" helper text · 02-20 email success/error feedback lacks role=status/role=alert (S15)

🎬 Full reproduction: continuous screen recording (address bar visible) · per-scenario screenshots in the Evidence section below.

Summary

On the photographer profile page (/photographer/[slug]), the large 360° tour viewer at the top of the page always renders. When a photographer has no virtual tour, it falls back to a tall "No virtual tour available yet" placeholder block. This empty block dominates the top of the page and looks unpolished.

We need to hide the tour viewer entirely when there is no tour, and just show the photographer detail (profile card, contact, about, information, reviews, portfolio).

"if there is not tour ... we need to hide this ... it does not look nice"

Current behavior

  • The profile page renders a hero <iframe> section at the top inside PhotographerProfile.
  • The tour URL is resolved by the usePortfolioIframe hook, which exposes validIframeUrl and isCheckingUrl.
  • Render states today:
    • isCheckingUrl === true → loading Skeleton.
    • validIframeUrl truthy → the 360° tour <iframe>.
    • otherwise → the "No virtual tour available yet" placeholder block (the part we want to remove).

Expected behavior

  • When there is a valid tour → keep showing the tour viewer exactly as it does now.
  • When there is no tour (no valid iframe URL after the check completes) → do not render the tour viewer section at all (no empty placeholder). The page should start with the photographer detail content instead, with no awkward empty gap or leftover spacing/border where the viewer used to be.
  • The loading skeleton should still show only while the URL is being checked, then collapse cleanly if no tour is found (no flash of the placeholder).
  • The "Contact photographer" call-to-action that lived inside the placeholder is already available elsewhere on the page (the contact button in the profile card), so no contact entry point is lost.

Acceptance criteria

  • Profile page with a valid tour still shows the 360° viewer (no regression).
  • Profile page with no tour shows no tour viewer and no "No virtual tour available yet" placeholder.
  • No empty container, border, or vertical gap remains at the top when the viewer is hidden.
  • No layout shift / flash of the placeholder while the tour URL is being validated.
  • Contact, about, information, reviews, and portfolio sections render normally in both cases.
  • Responsive: verified on mobile and desktop widths.

Technical notes (for the developer)

  • Component: src/components/photographer-profile.tsx — the hero <section> containing the iframe / placeholder.
  • Hook: src/components/pages/photographer/hooks/usePortfolioIframe.ts (validIframeUrl, isCheckingUrl).
  • Server data: src/app/photographer/[slug]/page.tsx resolves initialIframeUrl from getPhotographerPortfolioGothru (firstPortfolio.tourUrl / firstPortfolio.value).
  • Implementation hint: when !isCheckingUrl && !validIframeUrl, return null for the hero section (drop the placeholder branch) rather than rendering the empty state.

Testing scenarios (QA / tester)

Reach a profile page via the directory/search, or directly at /photographer/<slug>.

Scenario 1 — Photographer WITH a tour (regression check)

  1. Open a photographer profile that has a published 360° tour.
  2. Expect: the 360° tour viewer renders at the top and is interactive/fullscreen-able, exactly as before.
  3. Expect: all detail sections below (profile, contact, about, information, reviews, portfolio) render normally.

Scenario 2 — Photographer WITHOUT a tour (the fix)

  1. Open a photographer profile that has no tour.
  2. Expect: there is no large tour viewer and no "No virtual tour available yet" placeholder at the top.
  3. Expect: the page begins with the photographer detail content, with no empty box, border, or large blank gap at the top.
  4. Expect: the "Contact photographer" button is still reachable from the profile card.

Scenario 3 — Loading / no flash

  1. Open a profile with no tour on a slow/throttled connection (DevTools → Network → Slow 3G).
  2. Expect: while the tour URL is being checked, only the loading skeleton may appear.
  3. Expect: once the check completes with no tour, the viewer area collapses cleanly — the placeholder must not flash before disappearing.

Scenario 4 — Layout & responsiveness

  1. Repeat Scenarios 1 and 2 at mobile (~375px), tablet (~768px), and desktop (≥1280px) widths.
  2. Expect: no broken spacing, no double borders, and no horizontal scroll in either the "with tour" or "no tour" state.

Scenario 5 — Cross-section integrity

  1. On a no-tour profile, exercise Contact, Add review, Sub Locations, and Equipment dialogs, and the portfolio section.
  2. Expect: every feature works the same as on a profile that has a tour — hiding the viewer must not affect any other behavior.

Reference: see docs/PROJECT_ANALYSIS.md (§3.5 Portfolios, §2 Application Routes) for how the profile page and portfolio providers fit together.

issues.display_title: Issue #6: Fix Issue Unable to Select Google reCAPTCHA
issues.main_description_html:
Description

A bug was found where the user is unable to select / interact with the Google reCAPTCHA widget.

Bug video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1d7nQdWiDZeEYhp5XUoUPm2SetOh2dBLx/view?usp=drive_link

🧪 QA Tester Results — Issue #6

Tester: manual (ekosy9) · Surface: Profile → Add review → email → Google reCAPTCHA (profile ekosyaepulloh) · Result: 🔴 Bug reproduced — NOT resolved

Findings

  • The image challenge appears and the tiles can be selected — but a tile must be clicked twice ("double-checked") before the selection registers (the first click doesn't take).
  • After selecting the required squares and pressing VERIFY, nothing happens — the challenge never completes (no success / no refresh / no token returned), so the review email link cannot be sent.

Test method

  • Manual only. Google reCAPTCHA deliberately blocks programmatic interaction, so automation cannot validate selecting/verifying the challenge tiles (a Playwright tile-click times out even when a human can click). The one automatable signal — whether the challenge popup is obscured — showed it is on top / not blocked, so this is an interaction/verification bug, not a layout overlap.

Evidence

2026-06-17.15-51-22.mp4

Status: open — challenge tiles need a double-click and the VERIFY action is non-functional.
